name: d3rac-tron-contracts-hardhat-tests
description: Hardhat 3 logic-test harness for D3R-AC's TRON contracts. Nested as its own package (separate package.json, 'type': module) deliberately: Hardhat 3 requires an ESM-scoped package, while TronBox's config (../tronbox-config.js) requires CommonJS -- keeping them in separate package.json scopes avoids the collision entirely. Hardhat is NOT how you deploy to TRON; see ../tronbox-config.js and docs/deployment-guide.md for that. Contract sources are read from ../contracts (see hardhat.config.js paths.sources) -- these tests validate logic against a standard EVM only, since the contracts use no TRON-specific precompiles/opcodes.
